content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect pointer arithmetic when initializing the stack pointer. The original code added `stack_size` directly to `stack_start`, which resulted in the stack pointer (`stk`) being set to the end of the stack instead of the beginning. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the pointer arithmetic correctly calculates the address of the top of the stack by casting `stack_start` to the appropriate type and then adding `stack_size`.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrect pointer arithmetic when initializing the stack pointer. The original code added `stack_size` directly to `stack_start`, which resulted in the stack pointer (`stk`) being set to the end of the stack instead of the beginning. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the pointer arithmetic correctly calculates the address of the top of the stack by casting `stack_start` to the appropriate type and then adding `stack_size`.
Patch:
From 15d6070ad639b695b0abeef7474bc59a316017ac Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Benjamin Valentin <benpicco@zedat.fu-berlin.de>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2013 16:36:17 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] fix bug introduced by
 7cef6c46552a988c1c710a0a2404316a27ef1d43 stack_start used to be stack_start +
 stack_size, so re-setting stk to stack_start would set the pointer to the
 *end* of the stack instead of the beginning.

---
 cpu/arm_common/arm_cpu.c | 4 ++--
 cpu/msp430-common/cpu.c  | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/cpu/arm_common/arm_cpu.c b/cpu/arm_common/arm_cpu.c
index 997005bfc8..6040488ebe 100644
--- a/cpu/arm_common/arm_cpu.c
+++ b/cpu/arm_common/arm_cpu.c
@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@ void thread_yield() {
 char * thread_stack_init(void * task_func, void * stack_start, int stack_size)
 {
    unsigned int * stk;
-   stk = (unsigned int *) stack_start + stack_size;
+   stk = (unsigned int *) (stack_start + stack_size);
     stk--;
 
     *stk = 0x77777777;
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ char * thread_stack_init(void * task_func, void * stack_start, int stack_size)
     *stk = (unsigned int)sched_task_exit;       // LR
 
    stk--;
-   *stk = (unsigned int) stack_start - 4;   // SP
+   *stk = (unsigned int) (stack_start + stack_size) - 4;   // SP
 
    for (int i = 12; i>= 0 ; i--) {          // build base stack
        stk--;
diff --git a/cpu/msp430-common/cpu.c b/cpu/msp430-common/cpu.c
index c3be41ec58..7602d85184 100644
--- a/cpu/msp430-common/cpu.c
+++ b/cpu/msp430-common/cpu.c
@@ -100,7 +100,7 @@ void cpu_switch_context_exit(void){
 char *thread_stack_init(void *task_func, void *stack_start, int stack_size)
 {
     unsigned short * stk;
-    stk = (unsigned short *) stack_start + stack_size;
+    stk = (unsigned short *) (stack_start + stack_size);
 
     *stk = (unsigned short) sched_task_exit;
     --stk;
--
